flags.message: context.json freezes distribution_count=2 and band=elevated, but the two DISTRIBUTED entries belong to different filings: the May 19, 2026 distribution (Conference of 6/4/2026) was of the petitioner's motion for leave to proceed as a veteran, filed under the linked miscellaneous docket 25M81 and denied June 8 ('Motion Denied.'); the August 26 distribution (Conference of 9/28/2026) is the petition's own first distribution after it was docketed as paid No. 26-173 on August 6. Read as the petition's trajectory this is a relist-0 petition at its first conference, which under sal-v4 would sit in the baseline band, not elevated. I predicted from the actual posture (P(grant)=0.005) while stating the relist-increment from the frozen count as the contract requires; the evaluator's band yardstick for this cell is likely inflated by the linked-motion distribution. The dist-v2 parse may want to exclude distributions that precede the petition's own docketing on a linked M-docket.
